rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for exceeding something in weight, amount, importance, or value.

example.english: I think practicality can sometimes outweigh appearance.
example.traditional: 我覺得實用性有時超過外形。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 sat6 jung6 sing3 jau5 si4 ciu1 gwo3 ngoi6 jing4

rows.note: Use this for the more formal sense of one advantage, quality, or value surpassing another.

example.english: The long-term benefits brought by this policy outweigh the short-term costs.
example.traditional: 呢項政策帶來嘅長遠利益，勝過短期成本。
example.jyutping: nei1 hong6 zing3 caak3 daai3 loi4 ge3 coeng4 jyun5 lei6 jik1 sing3 gwo3 dyun2 kei4 sing4 bun2
